content: Mehe Bolla Gakkida Bosha
GODAY Muse, «Gibxe kawozaakko baada GODAA Ibraaweta Xoossay nena, ‹Taas goynnana mala ta asaa yedda;
Neni yeddontta ixxizaa gidikko,
heemettizason diza ne meheta bolla, parata bolla, hareta bolla, gaamellata bolla, miizata bolla, dorsata bollanne deyshata bolla wolqqama harge yeddana.
Gido attiin tani GODAY Isra7eele meheta giddoninne Gibxe asaa meheta giddon shaakoteth medhdhana. Isra7eele asaa mehetappe issoyka hayqqenna› ga» gides.
GODAY wode baridi, «Tani wonto hayssa ha biitta bolla ooththana» gides.
Wonteththa gallas GODAY hessa ooththides. Gibxe asaa mehey wuri hayqqides shin Isra7eele asaa meheppe issinakka hayqqabeekku.

Kawozi ha yo7oza paaccanaas as kiittidi Isra7eele nayta meheppe, haray attoshin pexi issinakka hayqqonttayssa erides. Gidikkoka kawoza wozinay minnidasoppe simmontta ixxida gishshas asaa yeddontta ixxides.
Kixa Harge
Hessafe guye GODAY, Musenne Aaroone, «Kushe kunththidi cooceppe bidinththa kuucci ekkidi Musey kawozi xeellishin hessa pude carko bolla laallo;
hayssi Gibxe biitta ubbaa bolla gudulla gidana; Gibxe biitta ubbaan asa bollanne mehe bolla kixay wodhdhana» gides.
Histtiin istti cooceppe bidinth ekkidi kawoza sinththan eqqida; Musey hessa pude carkon laalliin asaa bollanne mehe bolla giiyiza kixay kezides.
Marotikka istta bollanne Gibxe asaa ubbaa bolla wodhdhida kixay eqo diggiin Muse sinththan eqqanaas dandaybeettenna.
Gido attiin GODAY Muses gida malakka kawoza wozina minththida gishshas Museynne Aarooney yootizayssa kawozi siyontta ixxides.
Shachcha Ira
Hessafe guye GODAY Muses, «Wonto wontta maaladora denda baada kawozara gaaggada iza Ibraaweta GODAY nena, ‹Taas goynnana mala ta asaa yedda.
Ne yeddontta ixxiko ne bolla, daannata bollanne ne asaa bolla ta wolqqama hanqo ha7i yeddana; hessankka biitta bollan ta malay bayndayssa neni erana.
Tani hanno gakkanaas ta kushe yeddada nenanne ne asaa iita hargen qohidaakko ha biittaa bollafe pitta dhayssanakkoshin.
Tani nena paxa woththiday nena ta wolqqa bessanaassinne ta sunththi biitta ubbaa bollan xeygettana malassa.
Neni ha7ikka otorettada ta asaa yeddontta ixxadasa.
Hessa gishshas tani wonto hanni wode Gibxey Gibxe gidoosoppe hach gakkanaas bukki erontta wolqqama shach bukisana.
Ha7i neni ne mehenne gaden nees dizaaz ubbaa soo gelththana mala azaza; ays giikko soo gelontta buro gaden diza asa ubbaa bollanne mehe ubbaa bolla shachchi bukkidi wodhana› gides ga» gides.
Kawozi sunththida daannatappe GODAA qaalaas babbidayti ba aylletanne ba mehe eesotidi soo gelththida.
Gido attiin GODAA qaala kadhidayti ba aylletanne ba mehe karen aggaagida.
Hessafe guye GODAY Muses, «Gibxe biitta ubbaa bollan, asaa bolla, mehe bollanne biittafe mokkiza ubbaa bolla shachchi bukkana mala ne kushe salo denththa» gides.
Musey ba guufe pude salo denththida mala, GODAY dadanne shach yeddides; wolqqanththika duge biitta bolla wolqqamides. GODAY Gibxe biittan shach bukisides.
Shachchay bukkides; wolqqanththika wolqqamides; Gibxe derey dere gidoosoppe haa simmiin Gibxe biitta ubbaa bolla wodhdhida shachcha ubbaafe hayssi aadhdhiza iita shachcha.
He shachchay Gibxe biitta ubbaan gaden diza ubbaa, asakka mehekka shocides; biittafe mokkidaaz ubbaa duge zaaridi shocides; miththika ubbaa menththereththides.
Isra7eele nayti diza Geeseme biittay xalla shachchi bukkontta attides.
Kawoykka Musenne Aaroone xeygisidi, «Ha7i hekko, tani nagara ooththadis; GODAY xillo; taninne ta asay wordo.
Dadaynne shachchi nu bolla darida gishshas nuus GODAA woossite. Tani inttena yeddana; hekko hayssafe sinththan intte hayssan gam7eketa» gides.
Museykka izas, «Tani ha katamaappe keza baada woossanaas ta kushe GODAAKKO miccana; histtiko daday aggana; qasse shachchayka bukkenna; hessankka biittay GODAAS gididayssa neni erana.
Gido attiin neninne daannati GODAA Xoossaas ha7ikka babbonttayssa tani erays» gides.
Ciiyida kaththaynne tiyattida kaththay wuri dhaydes; gido attiin ciiyonttanne tiyattontta buro gakkiza kaththaa shachchay qohibeenna.
Hessafe guye Musey kawoza achchafe dendidi katamappe gaxa kezidi ba kushe GODAAKKO miccides; histtiin dadaynne shachchay eqqides; iraykka biitta bolla bukkizayssa aggides.
Gido attiin kawozi iray, shachchaynne daday aggidayssa be7ida wode qasseka nagara ooththides; izinne daannatikka bantta wozina minththida.
GODAY Muse doonara haasayda malakka kawaa wozinay minniin Isra7eele nayta yeddontta ixxides.
